content.text:
Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-30231.json runs/final-case-30231-r3

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --slot 2 --why "Earliest reachable slot at 4 sigma separation for the leading 0 vs 2 period pair, and it also splits candidate 3 from candidates 0, 1, and 2 at once"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --slot 5 --why "Earliest reachable slot at 4 sigma separation that discriminates both the 0 vs 1 and 0 vs 2 period pairs simultaneously"

input.description: Get updated diagnostics after second observation

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --slot 7 --why "Earliest reachable slot at 4 sigma separation for the now-dominant 0 vs 2 period pair, the leading candidate contest"

input.description: Get updated diagnostics after third observation

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --slot 17 --why "Earliest reachable slot at 4 sigma separation for the dominant 0 vs 1 pair, now the closest race after the last flip"

input.description: Get updated diagnostics after fourth observation

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --slot 19 --why "Earliest reachable slot at 4 sigma separation that discriminates both the 0 vs 1 and 0 vs 2 pairs at once, with two slots left to confirm the leader"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --slot 20 --why "Final budget slot, earliest reachable option within 20 percent of peak separation for the only remaining live pair, 1 vs 2, with candidate 0 already effectively eliminated"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-30231-r3 --why "Budget exhausted, candidate 1 near period 12.6 days holds 0.988 support after six targeted observations that eliminated candidates 3 and 4 and drove down 0 and 2, just short of the 0.997 resolution threshold so this is reported as a strong but not fully certified lean toward candidate 1"

content.text:
Campaign complete for `case-30231` (run `runs/final-case-30231-r3`).

**Summary:** Started with 5 candidates nearly tied (best support 0.33). Used all 6 observation slots, prioritizing early slots that discriminated the most contested pairs (and multiple pairs at once) each round:

1. Slot 2 (t=35.31) — killed candidate 3, dented candidate 4.
2. Slot 5 (t=40.17) — candidate 0 surged to lead.
3. Slot 7 (t=45.31) — flipped lead to candidate 1.
4. Slot 17 (t=59.48) — candidate 1 pulled ahead to 0.72.
5. Slot 19 (t=62.15) — effectively eliminated candidate 0 (0.001).
6. Slot 20 (t=63.35) — final confirmation on the remaining 1-vs-2 pair.

**Outcome:** Candidate 1 (period ≈ 12.6 d) ended at support 0.9884 against a resolution threshold of 0.997 — very close but not over the line. With budget exhausted, the run correctly finalized as an **abstention** rather than asserting a resolution the data didn't quite reach.
